displayName: Faithful 1:1 unit conversion (VB6 → .NET 10, forms as Blazor)
description: Mode A for VB6: the routine's whole unit is converted 1:1. A standard module (.bas) becomes a static class and a class module (.cls) an instance class, one C# file each, with the same names, the same members in the same order and the same call graph. A form (.frm) keeps its logic in src/<VB_Name>.cs (its controls as state objects and its event handlers, 1:1, a plain class tests can drive) and gets a Blazor page src/View_<VB_Name>.razor drawn from its layout. Every unit of the project shares the namespace Faithful.Vb6App, as VB6 shares one project scope. src/Vb6Runtime is the reviewed compatibility layer (controls, MsgBox through a dialog service, App, Err, default form instances); VB6's string, conversion, date and file functions come from .NET's Microsoft.VisualBasic library. Other units of the project are stubbed under src/Stubs/Units/, referenced DLLs and OCXs under src/Stubs/<Library>/. Files under src/Exemplar/ only show the model the target shape and are never shipped.

matches.fallback: Every VB6 routine: the module, class or form that contains it is converted as a whole, with the routine's signed spec (and the unit's other signed specs) as guardrails.
